{{Quote|Sarrish? Sarrish. Wait. What was the Battle of Sarrish?''"<br />"''It was one of the Republic's most devastating losses.''"<br />"''Sarrish. Yes. Yes, I remember now. So many soldiers were dying.|Gregor and Meebur Gascon|<ref name="Missing in Action" />}}
The '''Battle of Sarrish''', fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following a [[Second battle of Duro|Republic victory]] at [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] pursued Confederate forces to Sarrish, where they staged an [[Ground warfare/Legends|assault]] on the entrenched [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] from the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. With a [[Mountain/Legends|mountaintop]] [[anti-aircraft gun]] supplying heavy cover fire for the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on the surface, Kenobi split his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to fracture the enemy lines. After his [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] was shot down, [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], led the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the 212th's [["A" Squad]] to capture the anti-aircraft gun, using the droids' own [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] against them. Yet the Separatists ultimately routed the Republic forces, inflicting devastating [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Death/Legends|casualties]]. [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]] went missing in action during the battle, later ending up on the remote planet [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|This isn't an easy mission, Cody, but if we stick to the plan we'll come through this.''"<br />"''Copy, General. See you when this is finished.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Cody|<ref name="Routine Valor" />}}
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the third [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] capitalized on victories in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] by targeting holdings of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], in a campaign termed the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. Following the Republic's [[Second battle of Duro|recapture]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] chased the Separatists along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] into the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA" /> They ended up in the [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]],<ref name="Routine Valor" /> which [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Veedaaz Awmetth/Legends|Veedaaz Awmetth]] represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]],<ref name="DB Awmetth">{{DB|character|veedaaz|Awmetth, Veedaaz}}</ref> close to Separatist-loyal [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]], one of the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], became the site of contention between entrenched forces from the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]], led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]].<ref name="Routine Valor" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Two injured, four dead. Five if you count the pilot. But that's not the ''bad'' news&mdash;does that rock look familiar?''"<br />"''Yeah, the promontory we were warned about. We're right where we're ''not'' supposed to be.''"<br />"''General Kenobi ordered us not to try taking this section from the ground.''"<br />"''That's what he said. But what would the general do if he was here?''"<br />"''Troops, prepare to attack.|"A" Squad's lieutenant and Cody, upon crash-landing on Sarrish|<ref name="Routine Valor" />}}
[[File:LandingOnSarrish-RV.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kenobi, Cody, and the 212th prepare to land amidst heavy Separatist ground fire.]]
Kenobi and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody marshaled their 212th [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] onto [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] and prepared to land on Sarrish, with several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT carriers]] bringing along [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]]. Their flight path headed them eastward across Sarrish, bound for the plains where the Separatists had assembled their defenses&mdash;comprising [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]], along with such larger [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] as [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]]. In addition to surface [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] also employed an [[anti-aircraft gun]] from a [[Mountain/Legends|promontory]] to reinforce their southern flank. With the mountaintop gun harassing and dealing losses to their [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], Kenobi deemed a direct [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground assault]] too costly and instead ordered Cody and their [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to avoid the southern promontory and focus on shattering the enemy lines; they would disperse the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] and then concentrate their efforts on individual pockets of resistance. Kenobi, meanwhile, delegated the task of eradicating the anti-aircraft gun to his task force's gunships and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]], once their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] had completed their landing.<ref name="Routine Valor" />

As part of their assault plan, Kenobi divided his forces, leading an attack on one front while Cody oversaw another area of the [[Cloning/Legends|clones']] campaign. En route to the surface, Cody ordered all of his [[Squad/Legends|squads]] to maintain unit formations, though the Separatists shot down the gunship carrying him and [["A" Squad]] just thirty [[Standard second|seconds]] away from the designated landing zone. "A" Squad's gunship landed behind enemy lines, below the mountain housing the anti-aircraft gun&mdash;the very one that Kenobi had ordered them to avoid. The crash injured two troopers and [[Death/Legends|killed]] five others, including the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]]. Using the fallen craft as cover from droid fire, Cody met with the squad's [[Unidentified clone trooper lieutenant (Sarrish)|clone lieutenant]] to decide on their next move. Despite Kenobi's orders for the contrary, Cody and the [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] decided to target the enemy anti-aircraft gun, as out of the rest of their forces, they were in the best position to do so. Cody brought along troopers [[Eight-eight-six-seven]], [[Eight-eight-six-eight]], and [[Eight-eight-six-nine]] to attack the [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] gun while the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] remained with the squad to provide covering [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] fire for them.<ref name="Routine Valor" />

Upon sighting Cody and his comrades, the B1 battle droids on a ridge midway up the promontory commenced firing on the four approaching [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], who used their [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]]' [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension guns]] to scale the cliff. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] Cody reached the mountain summit, the three troopers accompanying him had all fallen to droid fire, but he nevertheless continued on with his task. As Cody grappled with the battle droids guarding the gun's ammunition stockpiles, the droid [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] turned his attention to Cody. While "A" Squad used their crashed gunship to shield themselves from oncoming droid fire, the lieutenant realized the enemy gunner's intentions in time and had his men open long-range fire on the gunner, eliminating the droid before he could target Cody. The clone [[Commander/Legends|commander]] summarily commandeered the unoccupied artillery [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]], turning it on the remaining Separatist infantry in the vicinity, including the droids bearing down on "A" Squad's crash site from an adjacent cliff. Regrouping at the remains of their gunship, the squad rallied to their victory.<ref name="Routine Valor" />

[[File:CodyAndTheGun-RV.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Intervening fire from "A" Squad allows Cody to take the anti-aircraft gun.]]
In the meantime, Kenobi encountered heavier fighting than anticipated in his own section of the campaign, receiving a minor hand wound. As Kenobi and the main body of 212th troops set up a staging area, Cody and his squad's survivors joined them there, reporting their own success with destroying the anti-aircraft gun.<ref name="Routine Valor" />

Yet despite the Republic's initial victories on Sarrish,<ref name="Routine Valor" /> the battle eventually turned against the 212th. The Separatists routed the Republic forces, inflicting a critical amount of casualties and resulting in the deaths of many clone troopers. Amidst the carnage of his comrades, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]]<ref name="Missing in Action" />&mdash;a veteran [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] attached to the 212th<ref name="Encyclopedia: Gregor">{{SWE|characters|gregor|Gregor}}</ref>&mdash;tried to find help for the wounded. However, after his elite [[Squad/Legends|squad]], [[Foxtrot Group/Legends|Foxtrot Group]],<ref name="Missing in Action" /> perished in the fighting,<ref name="FF-2014 80: R2-D2" /> Gregor disappeared from the battlefield and was reported as missing in action.<ref name="Missing in Action" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Do&hellip; do you remember how you escaped Sarrish?''"<br />"''No. I just remember seeing all those bodies. Bodies everywhere. I knew I had to get help, but that's where the memory stops.''"<br />"''Well, soldier, there's nothing you can do about that battle now, but you ''can'' help us. Our mission depends on it.|Meebur Gascon and Gregor|<ref name="Missing in Action" />}}
The Battle of Sarrish, as it became known, was remembered as one of the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] most devastating losses.<ref name="Missing in Action" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Gregor suffered from post-traumatic stress, which soon developed into a case of [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesia]].<ref name="FF-2014 80: R2-D2" /> He escaped from Sarrish<ref name="Missing in Action" /> and ended up on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]<ref name="Encyclopedia: Gregor" /> that crashed on the remote Outer Rim world of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], where he was taken in by [[Borkus/Legends|Borkus]], the proprietor of the [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]] diner. When [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] and the Republic's [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] was stranded on Abafar following their [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|capture]] of a Separatist [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]], they happened upon Gregor, who had begun to work as a [[Dishwasher/Legends|dishwasher]], with so little pay that he was essentially Borkus's [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]. Gascon and his all-droid squad discovered Gregor's past from his clone [[Identifying code/Legends|identifying code]] and convinced him to help them [[Escape from Abafar/Legends|escape]] from Abafar, as it was of the utmost priority for them to bring the encryption module back to the Republic. Thanks to Gregor's efforts, Gascon and his squad were able to pilfer a [[D-Squad's shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] from Separatist forces at a [[rhydonium]] mining facility and departed Abafar.<ref name="Missing in Action" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Gregor mentions the Battle of Sarrish. This is an event dramatized in an Expanded Universe comic book, 'Routine Valor,' which was the ''Star Wars'' title available for Free Comic Book Day in 2006.|[[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|Episode Guide]] for "Missing in Action"|<ref name="Explore: Missing in Action" />}}
[[File:Gregor.png|thumb|left|250px|"Missing in Action" tied the Battle of Sarrish into the origins of a new character, Gregor.]]
The Battle of Sarrish was created as the story for ''[[Routine Valor]]'', a single-issue [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 6]], [[2006]] for the annual [[Free Comic Book Day]].<ref name="Routine Valor" /> Following ''Routine Valor'', the battle received few references in ''[[Star Wars]]'' material&mdash;save for mentions in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' in [[2009]]<ref name="TEA" /> and a [[2010]] [https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCcomicpacksLC10.asp Comic Pack] from [[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|''The Legacy Collection'']]<ref name="Hasbro: Lieutenant & Trooper">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Legacy Collection|packtype=''Star Wars'' Comic Pack|pack=#10: Clone Trooper Lieutenant & Clone Trooper (''Routine Valor'')|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCcomicpacksLC10.asp}}</ref>&mdash;until [[January]] [[2013]], with the release of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] hundredth overall episode, "[[Missing in Action]]." The episode, which aired on [[January 5]] with the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]], connected the battle with the character of Gregor, an amnesiac clone [[Commando/Legends|commando]].<ref name="Explore: Missing in Action">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/missing-in-action-episode-guide|text="Missing in Action" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>

Besides attributing the battle's name, "Missing in Action" also introduced it as a devastating Republic loss,<ref name="Missing in Action" /> whereas the events of ''Routine Valor'' had implied a Republic victory, having ended with Commander Cody's success with taking the anti-aircraft gun.<ref name="Routine Valor" /> In the episode, Gregor's [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] database record misspelled it as the "'''Battle of Serrish'''" in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]],<ref name="Missing in Action" /> while the accompanying guide on [[StarWars.com]] spelled it correctly.<ref name="Explore: Missing in Action" />

Initially, ''Routine Valor'' did not provide a specific date for the battle, only indicating that it took place "sometime during the Clone Wars."<ref name="Routine Valor" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' established that it was part of the Outer Rim Sieges, which lasted from 20 to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> However, it is assumed that the battle took place in 20 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] due to the fact that it was shown to precede the events of "Missing in Action," which can be dated to 20 BBY.<ref name="Date" /> It is also unclear if ''The Essential Atlas''{{'s}} placement of the battle within the Outer Rim Sieges&mdash;which, being the final phase of the Clone Wars, were not specifically depicted in ''The Clone Wars'' television series&mdash;is still valid. Until [[Lucasfilm]] establishes a cohesive timeline, this article attempts to reconcile information from all source material.
